mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_purchase_order (po_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, po_number, currency, total_amount, status, payment_terms, shipping_terms, purchase_type, expected_delivery_date, actual_delivery_date, notes, created_by, approved_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{poId}, #{tenantId}, #{supplierId}, #{poNumber}, #{currency}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentTerms}, #{shippingTerms}, #{purchaseType}, #{expectedDeliveryDate}, #{actualDeliveryDate}, #{notes}, #{createdBy}, #{approvedBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scm_purchase_order SET supplier_id = #{supplierId}, po_number = #{poNumber}, currency = #{currency}, total_amount = #{totalAmount}, status = #{status}, payment_terms = #{paymentTerms}, shipping_terms = #{shippingTerms}, purchase_type = #{purchaseType}, expected_delivery_date = #{expectedDeliveryDate}, actual_delivery_date = #{actualDeliveryDate}, notes = #{notes}, created_by = #{createdBy}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE po_id = #{poId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT po_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, po_number, currency, total_amount, status, payment_terms, shipping_terms, purchase_type, expected_delivery_date, actual_delivery_date, notes, created_by, approved_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_purchase_order WHERE po_id = #{poId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT po_id, tenant_id, supplier_id, po_number, currency, total_amount, status, payment_terms, shipping_terms, purchase_type, expected_delivery_date, actual_delivery_date, notes, created_by, approved_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scm_purchase_order WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scm_purchase_order_line (po_id, line_id, product_id, seller_sku, quantity, received_quantity, unit_cost, total_price, expected_date) VALUES (#{poId}, #{lineId}, #{productId}, #{sellerSku}, #{quantity}, #{receivedQuantity}, #{unitCost}, #{totalPrice}, #{expectedDate})
mapper.select: SELECT po_id, line_id, product_id, seller_sku, quantity, received_quantity, unit_cost, total_price, expected_date FROM scm_purchase_order_line WHERE po_id = #{poId} ORDER BY line_id
